line: Checked November 19, 2026: 609,847 checks hold this plate's samples, sums, shares, frequencies, and sentences to the study's file, a recomputation in Python, and the paper, and 0 failed.

groups.name: every sample in the plate's data equals results/study/imf_example.csv
the window is EEG MMI at 160 Hz, C3, Cz, and C4 averaged and z-scored, stored to six digits, as the code and the paper say
the numbers the paper prints, and the figure it shows this window in, equal the plate's
at every sample, the six pieces add up to the signal within the file's rounding (exact decimal arithmetic)
every share, frequency, and residual the page computes equals a recomputation in Python (numpy, and the study's own frequency function)
every sentence and readout the plate can show matches its numbers (all 64 on/off states, the loop, and 30,000 fader states)
the idle loop starts on the whole signal and brings the pieces in one at a time, from the residue up to IMF 1
the cursor reads the samples themselves, a keyboard step is announced apart from the visible readout, and each fader settles on its level without overshooting
the chapter's ink and the second ink read on the plate's stage in both printings
